headline_marked: Fuel prices up Tk 20: [[Fuel price hike may prolong inflationary pressure]], warn economists
headline: Fuel prices up Tk 20: Fuel price hike may prolong inflationary pressure, warn economists
summary: Experts warn that the across-the-board increase in fuel prices will raise transport and production costs, potentially reversing recent easing of inflation.
details: The government has increased fuel prices by Tk 20 per litre across the board. Economists warn this move could add fresh inflationary pressure to the economy by raising transport, production, and marketing costs.

Centre for Policy Dialogue (CPD) Executive Director Nazneen Ahmed noted that the hike affects agriculture, transport, and industry. She highlighted that a Tk 20 increase is significant and will likely lead to higher public transport fares.

Nazneen argued that the government should have taken a more calibrated approach, suggesting that diesel and kerosene prices should have remained unchanged as they are heavily used by poorer households and industry.

The timing of the hike is particularly concerning as it coincides with a pay-scale increase for public servants. Experts suggest this simultaneous announcement could raise inflationary expectations and push prices higher.

Md Deen Islam, a professor of economics at University of Dhaka, stated that the increase would raise borrowing and marketing costs, potentially reducing the real income of private-sector workers who lack salary adjustments.

Former professor Anu Muhammad questioned the lack of consultation and justification for the sudden increase. He suggested the government could have reduced taxes and charges on fuel instead of passing the burden to consumers.
The government's decision is seen by some as a response to tight revenue constraints, choosing a quick means to reduce the subsidy burden on the state treasury.

headline_marked: Satkhira-4 [[MP Gazi Nazrul and first wife arrested]] over second wife's death
headline: Satkhira-4 MP Gazi Nazrul and first wife arrested over second wife's death
summary: The lawmaker and his spouse were detained following the recovery of 19-year-old Mariam Khatun's body from a Dhaka flat.
details: Satkhira-4 MP Gazi Nazrul Islam and his first wife, Maksuda Begum, have been arrested in a case filed over the alleged abetment of suicide of his second wife, 19-year-old Mariam Khatun.
The arrests followed the recovery of Mariam's body from a flat at NAM Bhaban in Dhaka yesterday evening.
The case was filed by Mariam's father, Masum Billah, at the Sher-e-Bangla Nagar Police Station around midnight.
According to police, the accused named in the case include MP Gazi Nazrul, his first wife Maksuda Begum, and Mariam's maternal uncle, Obaidur Rahman.
Mohammad Ibn Mizan, deputy commissioner of Tejgaon Division, confirmed the arrests and stated that the suspects will be produced before the court with a remand plea for seven days.
caption:
A lawmaker and his first wife have been arrested for allegedly driving his second wife to suicide.

Satkhira-4 MP Gazi Nazrul Islam and his first wife, Maksuda Begum, have been arrested in a case filed over the alleged abetment of suicide of his second wife, 19-year-old Mariam Khatun.

The arrests followed the recovery of Mariam's body from a flat at NAM Bhaban in Dhaka yesterday evening.

The case was filed by Mariam's father, Masum Billah, at the Sher-e-Bangla Nagar Police Station around midnight.

According to police, the accused named in the case include MP Gazi Nazrul, his first wife Maksuda Begum, and Mariam's maternal uncle, Obaidur Rahman.

Mohammad Ibn Mizan, deputy commissioner of Tejgaon Division, confirmed the arrests and stated that the suspects will be produced before the court with a remand plea for seven days.
